entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS tracker. I'm just so disappointed... the pulse monitor is completely inaccurate.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the pulse monitor or more of a preference issue with how it displays?
It's a fault. The readings are all over the place. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and honestly, this product feels like complete garbage.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize that the device isn't meeting your expectations. I can certainly walk you through some troubleshooting steps that often resolve this type of issue.
Oh, I just don't have time for all of that. I'm a busy person, and I really needed this to work right away. I don't want to fix it, I just want my money back. Can I please get a refund?
I see. You'd prefer to return it instead. Let me just pull up our return policy for you, one moment please.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've checked our system, and it states that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. When did you receive your VeloBand?
I received it exactly 10 days ago. I was so excited, but now... I really needed that money for other bills. I feel terrible about this.

Not a problem at all. Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. I will email a prepaid shipping label to the address on file right now.
Oh, really? That's… that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried I was going to be stuck with it.

You're very welcome. I've just sent that email. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful. Thank you.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
